incident: During GitHub learning persistence, an issue-update mutation was selected instead of the intended file update. Issue #1 was unintentionally reopened and immediately restored to closed/completed. Duplicate corrective close calls then repeated because the intended tool was still not selected.
rootCauses: state-changing connector tool selected without final intent/resource assertion
mutation recipient differed from the artifact being discussed
corrective action was repeated without recognizing that readback already proved restoration
recovery: read back the exact accidentally mutated resource
restore the previous known state with the smallest reversible mutation
read back once to verify restoration
do not repeat the corrective mutation after verified restoration
